headline: Houthi forces seize strategic territory near Bab al-Mandab strait
summary: Houthi rebels took control of areas near the Bab al-Mandab strait after pro-government forces withdrew from Dhubab airport and western Taiz to protect Aden.
why: The Bab al-Mandab strait is a critical maritime choke point linking the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden, handling substantial global merchant shipping and crude traffic.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Houthi control of key maritime choke points heightens shipping risk and oil transit disruption risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Territorial gains near strategic trade corridors increase supply security concerns for global shipping and oil routes.
